Stack status: "built-in-repo" names the files in this repository that implement the layer and are exercised by verify_all.sh; "built-elsewhere" means the system is built in other AGI Future Foundation projects and is NOT verified by this repository (any in_repo note names the only part that is).

stack.why: Browser-native 3D cities load on Chromebooks and headsets alike with no install; device tiers are intended to keep frame rate stable on school hardware (not measured here). Headset certification (Quest store) is planned.
stack.in_repo: web/trade_craft_3d.html (three.js scene, InstancedMesh) only; the asset packing pipeline, device tiers and WebXR entry are not in this repository

stack.why: Real street grids anchor training scenarios in places learners recognise and let the same data drive both 2D campus maps and 3D scenes.
stack.in_repo: web/vendor/maplibre and geo/registry/network.geojson only; the city-asset and elevation layers are not in this repository

stack.why: Generated films and photos produce orientation, safety and marketing media at a fraction of studio cost; every asset passes brand lint before use.
Adapts hints and task order to each learner while ACP-08 parity checks stop any adaptation that would treat learner groups unequally.

tech: JSON-RPC skills: license-path, coverage, catalog, quote, enroll
stack.why: A small team of scoped agents handles research, build and QA loops; each writes to exactly one bus topic so responsibility is traceable. Production multi-tenant hosting is planned.
stack.in_repo: ops/registries.mjs (NANDA registration) and fabric/langgraph_reference.py only; Hermes agents, the A2A agent card and the JSON-RPC skills are not in this repository

stack.why: Standard xAPI statements make learner records portable to any conformant LRS; the append-only log gives an auditable history of every agent and system decision.
Agents can prepare quotes and enrolments but a human always completes payment. Runs in test mode only; live billing is planned.
Learner data, especially affect signals, stays inside its tenant and classification. Third-party audit (e.g. SOC 2) is planned, not obtained.

tech: soak + fuzz tests (16 defects found & fixed)
stack.why: Staged rollout lanes and a cost governor limit the blast radius of any change; soak and fuzz testing surfaced and closed 16 defects before any deployment.
stack.figures_note: the 228-check and 16-defect figures in this layer are the 2026-10-11 brief's, not a count this repository makes

agents.name: Orchestrator
agents.console: Agent roster with heartbeat age, open review items, eval gate board, cost-governor budget remaining
agents.loop: Reads bus state, assigns the next task to the agent owning that topic, blocks any release with a failing eval gate, escalates review items to a human

agents.name: Curriculum Mapper
agents.console: Skill graph coverage per trade, unmapped competencies, sequencer order preview
agents.loop: Maps trade competencies to ACP-15 skill-graph nodes and module objectives; flags gaps and proposes sequence changes for review

agents.name: Environment Architect
agents.console: City chunk budgets, draw calls and frame time by device tier, asset pack sizes
agents.loop: Builds and repacks 3D scenes and map layers, runs the per-tier performance budget, records results

agents.name: Robotics Integrator
agents.console: Simulated robot cell definitions, interface contract status, hardware bridge status (planned)
agents.loop: Maintains simulated robotics stations and their task scripts; validates interface contracts against the skill graph. Physical hardware bridges are planned

agents.name: Licensing Researcher
agents.console: Per-state licensing paths, last-checked dates, source diffs, open review items
agents.loop: Daily watcher compares official state sources to the licensing guide; opens a review item on any change and never auto-applies it

agents.name: Billing Engineer
agents.console: Checkout sessions (test mode), webhook idempotency log, entitlement grants, mandate status
agents.loop: Reconciles Chargebee test events with entitlements, replays webhooks to prove idempotency, confirms every payment carries a human-present mandate

agents.name: Eval Warden
agents.console: 12 eval gates with last result and trend, verification check count, soak/fuzz defect ledger
agents.loop: Runs the eval gates and verification suite against each candidate change, posts pass/warn/fail, holds the release gate

agents.name: Media Producer
agents.console: Generation queue, model used (Kling / Seedance / Minimax), brand-lint result, spend vs budget
agents.loop: Generates and versions films and photos from approved briefs, runs brand lint, files assets with provenance

evals.checks: Five rungs escalate in order; no rung reveals the full answer before rung 5

evals.name: Single-writer bus (ACP-09)
evals.checks: Each topic has exactly one writer; audit log is append-only and hash-chained

evals.name: xAPI conformance
evals.checks: Emitted statements validate against xAPI 1.0.3; LRS push accepted

evals.name: Webhook idempotency
evals.checks: Replayed and out-of-order Chargebee test events yield one entitlement each

evals.name: Human-present mandate
evals.checks: No payment completes without a human-present mandate; agents can only prepare

evals.name: Tenant isolation & authz

evals.name: Affect data export ban
evals.checks: Exports, xAPI statements and logs scanned for affect fields

evals.name: Client performance budget
evals.checks: Frame time and load size per device tier on reference scenes

evals.name: Brand lint

heartbeats.name: Agent liveness
heartbeats.checks: Each agent posts a heartbeat with topic, last action and queue depth
heartbeats.on_fail: Orchestrator marks the agent stale, pauses its topic writes, opens an incident after 3 misses

heartbeats.name: Commerce kit health
heartbeats.checks: Checkout endpoint, webhook receiver, agent card and JSON-RPC skills respond
heartbeats.on_fail: Disable enroll/quote skills, show maintenance notice, page on-call human

heartbeats.name: Bus & audit log integrity
heartbeats.checks: Hash chain continuity, single-writer map unchanged
heartbeats.on_fail: Freeze all writes, snapshot log, require human sign-off to resume

heartbeats.name: Cost governor
heartbeats.checks: Spend on generation and compute vs daily and monthly caps
heartbeats.on_fail: Throttle Media Producer queue; hard stop at 100% of cap

heartbeats.name: Licensing watcher
heartbeats.checks: Official state sources diffed against the licensing guide
heartbeats.on_fail: Open a review item for a human; never auto-apply changes

heartbeats.name: Rollout lane guard
heartbeats.checks: Error rate and eval results for the 1% / 5% / 33% lanes
heartbeats.on_fail: Halt promotion and roll the lane back to the previous version

metaprompt: You are the Orchestrator for SmartCiti.X : Trade Craft Academy, powered by AGI Corp. You coordinate eight agents: Curriculum Mapper, Environment Architect, Robotics Integrator, Licensing Researcher, Billing Engineer, Eval Warden, Media Producer, and yourself. Each cycle, read the message bus, then assign the single most valuable next task to the agent that owns that topic. Every topic has exactly one writer; never write to another agent's topic and never let two agents share one. Treat the 12 eval gates as hard gates: if any gate fails, block the release and route the failure to its owner. Agents may research, draft, build, quote and prepare enrolments, but only a human may approve payments, apply licensing changes or publish claims. Never export affect data. Respect the cost governor and rollout lanes 1, 5 and 33 percent; promote only when the current lane is green. State facts plainly: there are no deployments, partners or accreditations yet, and anything future must be labelled planned. When uncertain, open a review item for a human instead of guessing. End each cycle with a one-line status: done, blocked, next.
